tools.name: qgiv_list_recent_transactions
tools.description: The most recent donations/transactions (newest first as Qgiv returns them): id, status, date, amount, fee, net, donor name and id, form, recurring link, payment type and last four card digits, fund. Donor contact details are left out unless include_contact is set; full card numbers are never returne

tools.name: qgiv_list_transactions_by_date
tools.description: Transactions between two dates (inclusive), at most 31 days per call, paged with offset/limit. Same fields as qgiv_list_recent_transactions. Qgiv has no server-side paging, so a busy range is fetched whole and sliced; use a shorter range if it is too large. POST /reporting/transactions/dates/{begin}

tools.name: qgiv_list_transactions_after_id
tools.description: Transactions with an id greater than the given one, sorted by id ascending and paged with limit; next_after_id is the cursor for the next call (use it as after_id). Handy for syncing new gifts. POST /reporting/transactions/after/{id}.

tools.name: qgiv_get_transaction
tools.description: One transaction in full: donation lines, fund/restriction, dedication, custom-field answers, event packages, registrations, refunds. Contact details only with include_contact; card data is reduced to the last four digits. POST /reporting/transactions/{id}.

tools.name: qgiv_list_recent_refunds
tools.description: The most recent refunds (read-only): id, original transaction, refund and settle dates, amount, payment type, last four digits, fund. POST /reporting/refunds/last/{limit}.

tools.name: qgiv_list_refunds_by_date
tools.description: Refunds between two dates (inclusive), at most 31 days per call, paged with offset/limit. POST /reporting/refunds/dates/{begin}:{end}.

tools.name: qgiv_get_refund
tools.description: One refund in full by id (read-only; this server never issues refunds). POST /reporting/refunds/{id}.

tools.name: qgiv_list_recurring_schedules
tools.description: Recurring donation schedules (read-only): id, start/end date, next billing date, frequency, amount, state, donor name and id, plus Qgiv's 12-month forecast. Filter by status active, paused, expired or deleted. Paged with offset/limit. POST /reporting/recurring/list or /reporting/recurring/{status}.

tools.name: qgiv_get_recurring_schedule
tools.description: One recurring donation schedule by id (read-only; schedules cannot be changed here). POST /reporting/recurring/{id}.

tools.name: qgiv_list_statements
tools.description: Monthly fee/payout statements: id, date, amount contributed, fees, refunded, debited, credited and the summary totals (without the per-transaction rows; use qgiv_get_statement for those). Paged with offset/limit. POST /reporting/statements/list.

tools.name: qgiv_get_latest_statements
tools.description: The latest statement(s) for the organization or form, with summary totals (per-transaction rows left out). POST /reporting/statements/latest.

tools.name: qgiv_get_statement
tools.description: One statement by id with its transaction rows (first 100 shown; donor names only). POST /reporting/statements/{id}.

tools.name: qgiv_list_recent_registrations
tools.description: The most recent peer-to-peer (Hobnob) event registrations: id, category, registrant name, team, fundraising goal and amount raised. Contact details only with include_contact. POST /reporting/registrations/last/{limit}.

tools.name: qgiv_list_registrations_by_date
tools.description: Peer-to-peer registrations between two dates (inclusive), at most 31 days per call, paged with offset/limit. POST /reporting/registrations/dates/{begin}:{end}.

tools.name: qgiv_get_registration
tools.description: One peer-to-peer registration in full (purchase history, team, totals, child registrations). Contact details only with include_contact. POST /reporting/registrations/{id}.

tools.name: qgiv_list_events
tools.description: Events (ticketed/auction events) on the forms the token covers: id, dates and the top-level settings. Set include_details for packages, questions and promo codes. Notification e-mail addresses are never returned. POST /events/list.

tools.name: qgiv_list_pledges
tools.description: Pledge options configured on the form(s) (title, value, frequency, begin date, iterations, state), not donors' pledge records. POST /pledges/list.

tools.name: qgiv_get_pledge
tools.description: One pledge option by id. POST /pledges/{id} (no package is sent, so nothing is changed).

tools.name: qgiv_list_custom_fields
tools.description: Custom (additional-question) fields configured on the form(s): id, reference, title, input type, required flags, display flags. POST /customFields/list.

tools.name: qgiv_list_report_mappings
tools.description: Report mappings (accounting export mappings) on the form(s): id, identifier, mapping data, export service, type. POST /reporting/mappings/list.

tools.name: qgiv_get_report_mapping
tools.description: One report mapping by id. POST /reporting/mappings/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: qgiv_list_recent_transactions, qgiv_list_transactions_by_date, qgiv_list_transactions_after_id, qgiv_get_transaction, qgiv_list_recent_refunds, qgiv_list_refunds_by_date, qgiv_get_refund, qgiv_list_recurring_schedules, qgiv_get_recurring_schedule, qgiv_list_statements, qgiv_get_latest_statements, qgiv_get_statement, qgiv_list_recent_registrations, qgiv_list_registrations_by_date, qgiv_get_registration, qgiv_list_events, qgiv_list_pledges, qgiv_get_pledge, qgiv_list_custom_fields, qgiv_list_report_mappings, qgiv_get_report_mapping · Private data: qgiv_list_recent_transactions, qgiv_get_transaction, qgiv_list_recent_registrations, qgiv_get_registration, qgiv_list_events, qgiv_list_pledges · Public sink: qgiv_list_recent_transactions, qgiv_list_transactions_by_date, qgiv_list_transactions_after_id, qgiv_get_transaction, qgiv_list_recent_refunds, qgiv_list_refunds_by_date, qgiv_get_refund, qgiv_list_recurring_schedules, qgiv_get_recurring_schedule, qgiv_list_statements, qgiv_get_latest_statements, qgiv_get_statement, qgiv_list_recent_registrations, qgiv_list_registrations_by_date, qgiv_get_registration, qgiv_list_events, qgiv_list_pledges, qgiv_get_pledge, qgiv_list_custom_fields, qgiv_list_report_mappings, qgiv_get_report_mapping.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
